title: Canonical Shop Domain + Event Spine
brief: Create the single source of truth for jobs, travelers, labor sessions, quantities, approvals, attachments, and live update events so every frontend and backend workflow can synchronize against the same contract.

phases.title: Contracts + Core State
phases.description: Define the canonical shop objects and wire them into durable backend state and transport surfaces.

units.title: Canonical shop-domain schema pack
entry_conditions: Current EmployeeEngine, TimeClockEngine, ERP route, Jobs page, and Scheduling page payloads have been inventoried.
The roadmap vocabulary for job, traveler, timer, and event ids is still flexible.
exit_conditions: A canonical schema exists for job, traveler, labor_session, quantity_actual, approval, attachment, and live_event.
REST and websocket payloads share one identifier, timestamp, and provenance language.
units.rollback: Delete the new shop schema files and restore callers to their prior local DTOs.

steps.instruction: Audit the active backend and frontend payload shapes, then normalize entity names and lifecycle states into one shop-domain lexicon.
Publish Zod and TypeScript contracts for the canonical entities plus their websocket event variants.
steps.validation: Representative shop payloads parse through the new contracts without lossy remapping.

deliverables.description: Canonical job, traveler, labor, quantity, approval, and attachment schemas.
Canonical websocket event schemas for job rooms, department rooms, and employee rooms.

units.title: ShopStateEngine + repository boundary
entry_conditions: The storage split between transient session state and persistent shop state is documented.
exit_conditions: A durable ShopStateEngine owns job/traveler/timer/quantity snapshots.
Persistence adapters are isolated behind a repository port instead of leaking directly into routes.
units.rollback: Remove the ShopStateEngine and repository port files, then revert route call sites.

steps.instruction: Introduce a ShopStateEngine that owns reads, writes, optimistic concurrency, and event-ready snapshots for the canonical entities.
Define repository ports for persistence so SQLite, E2 sync, and future durable stores can all target the same contract.
steps.validation: No route file mutates core shop state without going through the new engine.

deliverables.description: Central state owner for job lifecycle, traveler progress, and live shop snapshots.
Persistence port definitions for transactional shop storage and sync adapters.

units.title: REST + websocket contract alignment
entry_conditions: ShopStateEngine exists and exposes canonical read/write methods.
The existing ERP route drift has been cataloged.
exit_conditions: ERP HTTP routes and websocket room payloads share one contract source.
The backend exposes a dedicated live shop route surface instead of hiding all state behind seeded UI clients.
units.rollback: Revert the new route registrations and restore the previous erp.ts-only surface.

steps.instruction: Map the current frontend ERP expectations to canonical handlers and split live shop transport into its own route module.
Wire a dedicated live route surface and room map so the frontend can subscribe to job, department, and employee updates without bespoke adapters.
steps.validation: Every live route and room name is documented against a matching canonical schema.

deliverables.description: Dedicated HTTP route surface for live shop state and subscription bootstrap.
Aligned ERP routes that delegate to canonical shop-domain handlers.

custom_checks: Canonical ids and timestamps are consistent across REST and websocket contracts.
No route mutates shop state outside ShopStateEngine.

phases.title: Forge-Triple Controls
phases.description: Add the slash-command, skill, hook, and test surfaces that keep the new contracts discoverable and guarded.

units.title: Forge-triple shop-domain starter assets
entry_conditions: Canonical shop contracts exist and route names are stable.
The team needs an execution surface that can bootstrap future forge-triple work quickly.
exit_conditions: A dedicated command and skill template exist for inspecting live shop status, contract health, and subscription rooms.
Future roadmap units can reuse the same guidance without re-deriving the contract language.
units.rollback: Remove the command and template assets if the contract naming changes materially.

steps.instruction: Author a command surface that explains how to inspect live shop status, contract health, and subscription rooms.
Create a reusable skill template for future domain-contract work so forge-triple sessions start from the same playbook.
steps.validation: The new command and skill reference the canonical route names, entity ids, and event rooms.

deliverables.description: Slash-command guidance for inspecting canonical shop contracts and live room health.
Reusable forge-triple skill template for shop-domain and event-contract work.

units.title: Contract-drift hook + regression suite
entry_conditions: Canonical shop contracts and command surfaces are in place.
The team is ready to prevent future UI/backend route drift automatically.
exit_conditions: A hook warns on contract drift before route or page changes land.
The canonical contract test suite fails closed when ids, payloads, or room names drift.
units.rollback: Disable the new hook and remove the regression suite if it blocks unrelated work unexpectedly.

steps.instruction: Implement a drift-detection hook that compares contract exports against route and page consumers during edit time.
Write the contract regression suite and run a Ralph scrutiny pass against edge cases and migration notes.
steps.validation: Breaking changes to ids, room names, or canonical payload fields fail the suite immediately.

deliverables.description: Edit-time guard that detects backend/frontend contract drift before it ships.
Regression suite covering canonical shop contracts, route parity, and live room naming.

custom_checks: The shop contract command and skill assets reference the same canonical paths shipped in P1.
The drift hook catches a seeded contract mismatch in test.

role_matrix.name: Schema Architect
role_matrix.description: Define durable contracts, DTOs, and invariants.

role_matrix.name: Implementer
role_matrix.description: Build production engines and source modules.

role_matrix.name: Integrator
role_matrix.description: Wire routes, events, and UI surfaces.

role_matrix.name: Prompt Engineer
role_matrix.description: Create forge-triple skills and command surfaces.

tool_map.purpose: Plan units, write deliverables, and run build/test gates.
Checkpoint contract migration state while the domain spine is introduced.
Inspect route maps and keep transport surfaces aligned.
Generate and maintain forge-triple skill surfaces.

existing_leverage.usage: Reuse the existing event bus as the backbone for live shop state transitions.
Reuse room-based websocket delivery instead of creating a second realtime stack.
Seed employee, department, and role vocabulary for the canonical domain.
Use the existing shift and job-time logic as the starting point for labor-session contracts.

scrutiny_config.escalation_rule: if pass 4+ finds CRITICAL, flag for human review
